decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, Existing Location Map, Proposed Location Plan, Flood Risk Assessment Received: 29 November 2012 
Proposed Cellar (293-140-AL(04).dwg R.01), Proposed Ground Floor P1 (293-141-AL(04).dwg R.01), Proposed Ground Floor P2 (293-141-AL(04).dwg R.01), Proposed First Floor P1 (293-142-AL(04).dwg R.01), Proposed First Floor P2 (293-142-AL(04).dwg R.01), Proposed Second Floor P1 (293-143-AL(04).dwg R.01), Proposed Second Floor P2 (293-143-AL(04).dwg R.01), Proposed Roof P1 (293-144-AL(04).dwg R.01), Proposed Roof P2 (293-144-AL(04).dwg R.01), Proposed Side Elevation (293-152-AL(05).dwg R.01), Proposed Cross Section A-A (293-160-AL(06).dwg R.01) Received: 03 December 2012 
Proposed First Floor P1 (293-142-AL(04).dwg R.02), Proposed First Floor P1(293-142-AL(04).dwg R.02), Proposed Rear Elevation (293-151-AL(05).dwg R.02) Received: 23 January 2013 
Proposed Side Elevation (293-153-AL(05).dwg R.03) Received: 24 January 2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side dormer shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The window formed in the dormer window shall be non-opening below 1.7m from floor level.
description: Erection of a single storey rear ground floor extension, a rear roof extension with a side roof window, three side roof lights and internal alterations to existing dwelling.
